subsystems.name: Microphone array
subsystems.role: captures speech from several metres away rather than only the person holding the device.
parts: several MEMS microphones spaced a few centimetres apart

subsystems.name: Capture electronics
subsystems.role: keeps listening for hours on a small battery while buffering audio safely.
parts: low-power system-on-chip with a voice-activity detector
flash storage for several gigabytes of audio

subsystems.name: Connectivity and sync
subsystems.role: moves recordings to a phone or cloud without losing them.

subsystems.name: Speech recognition
subsystems.role: turns the audio stream into text with timestamps.
parts: acoustic and language model (often a transformer)

subsystems.name: Speaker attribution
subsystems.role: marks who said what in a multi-person conversation.

subsystems.name: Summarisation layer
subsystems.role: condenses the transcript into notes, decisions and action items.

subsystems.name: Privacy and consent controls
subsystems.role: lets people know they are being recorded and limits what is kept.
parts: encryption in transit and at rest

buildSteps.title: Design the acoustic front end
buildSteps.detail: Choose microphone count and spacing for the intended pickup distance, and simulate how the array performs in a reverberant room.

buildSteps.title: Engineer the power budget
buildSteps.detail: Decide how much processing runs continuously on the device versus being batched and uploaded, since always-on capture dominates battery life and heat.

buildSteps.title: Write the firmware
buildSteps.detail: Implement voice detection, ring buffering, audio compression, secure storage and sync with retry so a dropped connection never loses a meeting.

buildSteps.title: Select and adapt speech models
buildSteps.detail: Test recognition accuracy on far-field, noisy, accented audio; add names and jargon as a custom vocabulary; measure word error rate, not just vibes.

buildSteps.title: Add speaker diarisation
buildSteps.detail: Cluster voice embeddings across the recording and align them with the transcript so each line is attributed.

buildSteps.title: Build the summarisation pipeline
buildSteps.detail: Chunk long transcripts, prompt the model for summary, decisions and action items, and validate the output against a fixed schema before showing it.

buildSteps.title: Harden the cloud and app
buildSteps.detail: Encrypt audio and transcripts, define retention defaults, and give users one-tap deletion and export.

buildSteps.title: Field-test the consent workflow
buildSteps.detail: Trial the device in real meetings and lectures to confirm the recording notice and indicator are clear and that accuracy holds up.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and manufacture
buildSteps.detail: Test each unit's microphones acoustically on the line so array performance is consistent, then write OTA update and model-refresh plans.

prerequisites.why: without accurate transcription in real rooms the rest of the pipeline has nothing to work on.
they convert raw transcripts into short, readable notes and action items.
continuous listening for a full day on a pocket-sized battery depends on it.
works well for two speakers but degrades with overlap, crosstalk and many voices.
needed for offline use and stronger privacy, but small devices still can't run the largest models.
recordings must survive dead zones and be stored safely to be trusted.

pathway.milestone: cloud transcription with summaries and speaker labels, delivered within minutes
pathway.unlocks: meetings and lectures captured without anyone typing.

pathway.milestone: most recognition and summarisation running on the device, offline
pathway.unlocks: use in secure, remote or privacy-sensitive settings.

pathway.milestone: notes wired into calendars and task tools so action items are filed automatically
pathway.unlocks: the recorder becomes part of a workflow rather than a standalone gadget.

pathway.milestone: consent-aware long-term memory across many recordings, searchable by speaker and topic
pathway.unlocks: project histories and personal knowledge bases, provided retention stays under user control.
